scope_limits: Dependency seeds are declared normal, build, dev, target and workspace dependencies in the listed manifests. This is not a resolved Cargo dependency graph.
Source checks inspect named module declarations, selected initialization sites and persisted fields in listed files. They are not a Rust compiler, macro expander or whole-program analysis.

New or changed dependency declarations and new feature/module/init/public-field names require review. Other new code paths, renamed settings, arbitrary service factories and dependencies in unlisted crates can escape this scope.
Known forbidden optional or non-default features still fail because the requirement is removal from the product source, not runtime disabling.
Native builds, Windows/ConPTY behavior, terminal I/O, local session recovery, settings surface and host-originated network activity require separate verification.
Third-party programs launched inside a terminal may use the network and their own agent functionality. Audit applies to the embedded Warp product.
